senses.gloss: छिन्न-नस्य छिन्न-नस्य, adj. with broken nose-bridle, Yājñ. 2, 299.
छिन्न- + शृङ्खल छिन्न- + शृङ्खल, adj. (vb. छिद्), having broken (his) chain (viz. an elephant), Daśak. in Chr. 190, 9.

छिन्न- + श्वास छिन्न- + श्वास (vb. छिद्),
 I. adj. one who breathes at irregular intervals, Suśr. 1, 115, 17.
 II. m. a kind of asthma, ib. 2, 294, 7.
